# The Beach Bay Kanyakumari

> Luxury hotel in Kanyakumari, India, set at the confluence of three oceans — the Arabian Sea, the Bay of Bengal, and the Indian Ocean. Offers sea-view rooms and suites, an infinity pool, fine dining, a spa, and event facilities, with easy access to Kanyakumari's landmarks and temples.

## Pages

- [Home](https://thebeachbay.in/): Book your stay at The Beach Bay Kanyakumari. Luxury sea view rooms, infinity pool, beachfront location and direct-booking rates.
- [Rooms & Suites](https://thebeachbay.in/rooms): Affordable luxury rooms and suites with sea views at The Beach Bay Kanyakumari.
- [Facilities](https://thebeachbay.in/facilities): World-class facilities — infinity pool, fine dining, a fully equipped spa, and a conference centre.
- [Gallery](https://thebeachbay.in/gallery): Photos and videos of the hotel's rooms, sea views, dining, and the surrounding coastline.
- [Nearby Destinations](https://thebeachbay.in/destinations): Guide to must-visit spots near the hotel — temples, monuments, and landmarks within easy reach.
- [Blog](https://thebeachbay.in/blog): Travel notes, tips, and insider guides to Kanyakumari's coast and countryside.
- [About Us](https://thebeachbay.in/about-us): The hotel's story, heritage, and team.
- [Contact Us](https://thebeachbay.in/contact-us): Directions, enquiries, and reservations.
